name: page-tint-glows-through-a-theme
description: A space with a Theme Studio picture kept the page's colour off its chrome: the theme painter drew the picture and the grain and never the edge glow, so with per-space theming on, the band beside the card stayed the picture whatever page was in front. Same two declared-colour pages as page-tint-follows-the-page, same switch, on the same space now wearing a slate gradient. The band beside the card must still move from crimson toward teal, and the sidebar column must keep the picture.

actions.expression: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.row.tabrow')].find(x => x.textContent.includes("Teal")); if (!r) return 'no-row'; r.click(); return 'clicked'; })()
actions.note: Found by title, so a row height change cannot retarget the click.
the teal page committed, read from the page itself

assertions.label: the-switch-really-happened
assertions.desc: THE CONTROL: the teal page committed, so the measurement below is not grading two captures of the same page. Without it a region that never moved would pass for the wrong reason - the switch never having happened.
THE CONTROL: the sidebar column keeps the picture across the switch, so the theme's painter stayed on the root and only the band moved.
THE MEASUREMENT: the band beside the card follows the page on a themed space. Before the fix this region read the picture alone and never moved.
